sources.title: Electronic Health Records: Ongoing Stakeholder Involvement Needed in the Department of Veterans Affairs' Modernization Effort
keyFacts: VA established 18 electronic health record councils composed of clinicians, staff, and other experts.
VA held eight national workshops between November 2018 and October 2019 and local workshops at two planned initial sites.
GAO recommended ensuring the involvement of all relevant facility stakeholders in configuration decisions.
GAO identified a need for clearer terminology and more detailed workshop descriptions to facilitate participation.
sources.usageLimitations: Historical federal modernization case. Use documented facts and recommendations only. Workshop count does not by itself prove engagement quality.

sources.title: Electronic Health Records: VA Needs to Address Data Management Challenges for New System
keyFacts: GAO reported quality problems in selected transferred data.
GAO reported that reports were made available without consulting all users and therefore might not meet all user needs.
GAO recommended actions intended to improve data management and stakeholder engagement for reporting.
sources.usageLimitations: Federal healthcare context. Do not generalize individual findings to every system or infer a single cause.

sources.title: Electronic Health Records: Challenges with VA's New System Call for Management Improvements
keyFacts: GAO reported that many users said they were not adequately trained to use the new system.
GAO reported significant user concerns about the system.
GAO reported that VA had not established goals to assess user satisfaction.
GAO assessed change-management activities against leading practices and identified gaps.
sources.usageLimitations: Government assessment. Use official findings with the publication date and do not claim that training alone explains the program's challenges.

sources.title: Electronic Health Records: VA Making Incremental Improvements in New System but Needs Updated Cost Estimate and Schedule
keyFacts: VA paused deployments in 2023 because of user concerns.
GAO reported incremental configuration and system improvements during the pause.
GAO reported that additional complex projects required significant stakeholder coordination with live sites.
GAO reported that the program lacked an updated life-cycle cost estimate and integrated schedule reflecting changes and delays.
sources.usageLimitations: Time-sensitive government assessment. Reverify before publication. Incremental activity does not by itself prove value or readiness.

sources.title: VA Electronic Health Record Modernization: Critical Actions Needed to Support Accelerated System Deployments
keyFacts: GAO reported that earlier decision procedures did not always ensure involvement of key stakeholders.
GAO continued to identify user adoption, satisfaction, testing, schedule, cost, and program-management actions as important to deployment readiness.
GAO reported that deployments had been paused while improvement work continued.
sources.usageLimitations: Government testimony summarizing a long-running program. Do not represent open recommendations as completed.
